name: raise-the-bar
description: Claude Code plugins for agent-written code that still has to be safe to ship: guard hooks, engineering skills and decision councils.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Guard hooks for agent-written code: secrets stopped at commit, no push to a protected branch without a recorded test pass and review of the exact code, and production locked until a human approves. With a read-only reviewer agent and three review skills.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Engineering skills that hold agent work to a senior bar: build-it, clean-code, performance, bug-hunt, ux-review, worktree-first, bug-retro and later.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Decision skills where opposed viewpoints argue one question and the dissent is kept: boardroom, senior-council, strategy and red-team, with a read-only council seat agent.
